scripted_timeline.magnitude: BTC -25% (fell from ~$21k on 5 Nov to ~$15.5k by 21 Nov); crypto lending contagion (BlockFi, Genesis) froze
scripted_timeline.effect: global credit-crunch event: crypto-backed loans unavailable until 2023Q3; -1 notch to all miner credit ratings for 2 quarters

scripted_timeline.magnitude: 1M users in 5 days
scripted_timeline.effect: flips global flag 'AI demand curve begins'; AI Demand Index starts rising from ~8 (see market_quarterly.csv)

scripted_timeline.magnitude: filed owing hundreds of millions; continued mining through bankruptcy; emerged 24 Jan 2024 with ~$400M debt equitized
scripted_timeline.effect: unlocks the distressed-lifeline card and Act II's opening distressed-site auctions

scripted_timeline.magnitude: largest US bank failure since 2008; ~$42B withdrawn in a day; Signature Bank closed 12 Mar
scripted_timeline.effect: 1-quarter credit freeze: no new debt; cash above a threshold at risk unless moved

scripted_timeline.magnitude: on-demand spot as high as ~$8-11/GPU-hr in the tightest pockets; multi-month allocation lead times (up to 4-5 months)
scripted_timeline.effect: GPU allocation queue interrupt active; full-stack projects wait +1 quarter for chips unless paying a premium

scripted_timeline.magnitude: $2.3B GPU-backed facility (Magnetar Capital & Blackstone)
scripted_timeline.effect: unlocks the GPU-backed DDTL instrument for the player

scripted_timeline.magnitude: 11 spot BTC ETFs approved simultaneously (BlackRock IBIT, Fidelity FBTC, etc.)
scripted_timeline.effect: institutional-inflow event: steadier BTC price floor, mining-revenue volatility falls one notch

scripted_timeline.magnitude: block subsidy 6.25 -> 3.125 BTC (block 840,000)
scripted_timeline.effect: mining revenue per hash halves overnight; older ASICs switch off if unprofitable at current hashprice

scripted_timeline.magnitude: ~200MW/12yr hosting deal, later expanded to 382MW/$6.7B cumulative
scripted_timeline.effect: 'miner pivots to AI' becomes the market story: EV/MW re-rates from ~$0.4-1M (pure mining) toward $3-12M (AI deal announced) for any miner that signs a comparable deal; +2 to mining-company multiples

scripted_timeline.magnitude: H100 hyperscaler on-demand still ~$6-8/GPU-hr; neocloud ~$4-5/hr
scripted_timeline.effect: best window in the whole Act to lock in a full-stack or shell contract; contracts signed in 2024 beat post-Jun2025 contracts by >=30% IRR (confirmed anchor, see report §12)

scripted_timeline.magnitude: PJM 2025/26 capacity price ~$269.92/MW-day vs $28.92 the prior year (~9x); every Warrenton VA council member who backed an Amazon data center loses re-election (5 Nov 2024)
scripted_timeline.effect: Virginia/PJM power price and Ratepayer Anger jump sharply; Heat events start in that region

scripted_timeline.magnitude: $500B planned over 4 years (OpenAI/SoftBank/Oracle/MGX); $100B committed immediately
scripted_timeline.effect: unlocks megadeal-scale tenant RFPs (JV partner and backstop instruments become available)

scripted_timeline.magnitude: Nvidia loses a record ~$589B in single-day market cap (~17% share drop)
scripted_timeline.effect: efficiency-shock scare event: AI Demand Index growth pauses for 1 quarter; a 'maybe we're overbuilding' card fires (does not reduce index long-term -- Jevons rebound within 2 quarters per real data)
scripted_timeline.source: Forbes; Yahoo Finance -- FLAGGED AS MISSING FROM 18-act-ii-design.md §11, RECOMMEND ADDING

scripted_timeline.magnitude: priced at $40/share (below expected range), ~$1.5B raised, ~$23B implied valuation; OpenAI signs $11.9B/5yr same month
scripted_timeline.effect: AI-infra multiple peaks (see capital_act2.json era_multiple_ev_ebitda.ai_infra ~30x around this date); CoreWeave rival card becomes public, backlog visible to the player

scripted_timeline.magnitude: AWS cuts H100/H200/A100 instance pricing by up to ~45%
scripted_timeline.effect: spot-price-shock interrupt: uncontracted capacity can be locked into a contract at the new (lower) price, or left on spot

scripted_timeline.magnitude: Google backstops $1.4B of Fluidstack's Cipher lease, takes ~5.4% CIFR equity via warrants
scripted_timeline.effect: unlocks the backstop instrument for the player; demonstrates the mechanic with real numbers

scripted_timeline.magnitude: $27.3B off-balance-sheet SPV, Blue Owl 80%/Meta ~20%
scripted_timeline.effect: unlocks the JV-partner instrument at scale; 'off-balance-sheet' flavour card (Enron comparisons in the press)

scripted_timeline.magnitude: Michael Burry's public critique (11 Nov) argues real GPU economic life is 2-3yr vs the 5-6yr hyperscalers assume; Nvidia publishes a rebuttal memo (25 Nov)
scripted_timeline.effect: a depreciation-policy card: player picks aggressive (longer, flatters EBITDA/credit rating) vs conservative (shorter, safer); an 'auditor scrutiny' random event can punish the aggressive choice later

scripted_timeline.magnitude: ~$130B of US data-center projects blocked/delayed in Q1 2026 alone (75+ projects); running tally grew toward ~$200B later in the year
scripted_timeline.effect: Heat +10 everywhere; a portion of planned MW is hard-cancelled regardless of capital available -- the community-opposition mechanic caps growth, not just slows it
scripted_timeline.source: Data Center Watch Q1 2026 report; Gizmodo

scripted_timeline.magnitude: 71% of Americans oppose a data center in their own community (Gallup); NY statewide moratorium (EO 62, 14 Jul); Arizona incentive pause (13 Jun); New Jersey Fair Share Act (7 Jul); Illinois incentive pause (1 Jul)
scripted_timeline.effect: regional moratorium cards fire in NY/Arizona/NJ/Illinois-equivalent region tags; PJM/Ohio/Georgia Ratepayer Anger crosses moratorium threshold more easily for the rest of the Act

scripted_timeline.magnitude: CoreWeave DDTL 5.0 ($3.1B, SOFR+450bps, non-IG tenants) and DDTL 5.5 (~$2.6B, wider still) after DDTL 4.0's SOFR+225bps IG-rated deal in March
scripted_timeline.effect: lender spreads +150-250bps for any new GPU-backed debt for the rest of the Act; credit rating downgrade risk rises for full-stack players with weak tenants

scripted_timeline.magnitude: Oracle sends a force-majeure notice on Project Jupiter, NM (~$165B valued project); Oracle stock -3% same day; Oracle CDS at record highs earlier in 2026
scripted_timeline.effect: a tenant force-majeure card: a signed AI-lab-tier tenant may suspend lease payments without formally defaulting; triggers a sector-wide credit/sentiment shock (cap rates widen in the 2026Q4 aftershock quarter, see capital_act2.json design flag)

missing_events_flagged_for_addition.note: CoreWeave's own $11.9B/5yr OpenAI deal, later expanded +$6.5B -- a major backlog driver parallel to Stargate, worth its own line since it directly inflates CoreWeave's rival-card RPO
~$1B all-stock unsolicited bid, rejected by CORZ shareholders 30 Oct 2025 -- good rival-interaction texture, ties the Core Scientific and CoreWeave rival cards together
bundle with the depreciation-debate card as a two-beat exchange (accusation -> rebuttal)

event_cards.title: The Exchange That Wasn't
event_cards.body: An exchange everyone trusted just imploded overnight. Crypto lenders freeze withdrawals. Your BTC treasury is worth 25% less by Monday, and every crypto-backed loan desk has gone dark.

choices.label: Sell treasury now, lock in the loss
Hold and wait for a bounce

event_cards.default: Hold and wait for a bounce

event_cards.title: A Chatbot Everyone's Talking About
event_cards.body: Your nephew won't stop showing you what some new chatbot wrote. Feels like a toy. A few of your GPU-cloud customers start asking odd questions about 'inference workloads.'

choices.label: Pull cash together for whatever comes next

event_cards.title: A Bankrupt Miner's Site, Going Cheap
event_cards.body: A rival just filed Chapter 11. Its 20MW site is going to auction with the lights still on and a bridge lender circling.

choices.label: Bid with the bridge loan (14%, 8 quarters)

event_cards.basis: Core Scientific Ch.11 Dec 2022; Argo-Galaxy Helios $65M sale (sourced)

event_cards.title: Your Bank Just Failed
event_cards.body: A regional bank that half the tech industry banked with is gone by Friday. Regulators say deposits are safe. Nobody quite believes it, and nobody's writing new loans this quarter.

choices.label: Move cash to a bigger bank now (costs a week of ops)

event_cards.title: The Allocation List
event_cards.body: Your Nvidia rep says the list is long and getting longer. You can jump three places for a premium, or wait your turn.
event_cards.basis: 2023-24 H100 allocation shortage, up to 4-5 month lead times (sourced)

event_cards.title: A Strange Fee Windfall
event_cards.body: Something called 'Ordinals' has clogged the mempool with tiny inscriptions, and fees have spiked to a two-year high. Your miners are printing extra for a few weeks.

event_cards.title: Wall Street Shows Up
event_cards.body: Eleven bitcoin ETFs launch on the same day. Institutional money starts flowing in a way your industry has never seen. Your treasury looks a lot better this morning.

event_cards.title: The Halving
event_cards.body: Block 840,000. Overnight, every satoshi your machines mine is worth half as much in new coin. Some of your older ASICs are now mining at a loss.

event_cards.title: The Market Notices
event_cards.trigger: condition: first AI hosting deal signed
event_cards.body: A rival just leased 200MW to a name-brand GPU cloud, and its stock re-rated overnight. Analysts are calling this quarter's theme 'miners pivoting.' Your own numbers look different to the market now.

choices.label: Let the deal speak for itself

event_cards.default: Let the deal speak for itself

event_cards.title: Your Power Bill Just Went Up Nine Times
event_cards.body: The regional grid operator's capacity auction just cleared at nearly nine times last year's price. Every megawatt you run in this region costs more from next quarter.

choices.label: Lobby for a rate freeze (costs Bandwidth, uncertain)

event_cards.title: The Council Lost Its Seats
event_cards.body: Every council member in a nearby county who backed a big data-center project just lost re-election. Your neighbors are watching what you build next.

event_cards.title: A Half-Trillion-Dollar Rumor
event_cards.body: A consortium just announced plans to spend $500B on AI infrastructure over four years. Everyone with a powered site is suddenly fielding calls.

event_cards.title: A Cheap Model Spooks the Market
event_cards.body: A little-known lab just released a model that reportedly cost a fraction of what everyone assumed to train. Nvidia's market cap drops by more than half a trillion dollars in a day. Is this the end of the AI buildout, or a blip?
event_cards.basis: DeepSeek shock, 27 Jan 2025 (sourced) -- game payoff: demand rebounds within ~2 quarters per real AI Demand Index data

event_cards.title: A Neocloud Goes Public
event_cards.body: The GPU-cloud pioneer everyone's been watching just IPO'd, priced below the range but with a backlog that makes your eyes water. AI-infra valuations are the story of the quarter.

event_cards.title: Compute Just Got Cheaper
event_cards.body: A hyperscaler just cut its GPU rental prices by nearly a third. Every uncontracted GPU-hour you were about to sell on spot is worth less this afternoon.

choices.label: Lock uncontracted capacity into a contract at the new price

event_cards.default: Lock uncontracted capacity into a contract

event_cards.title: A Big-Tech Guarantee
event_cards.body: A hyperscaler is willing to guarantee your weaker tenant's lease payments -- for a slice of your company.

event_cards.title: A Private-Credit JV
event_cards.body: An infrastructure fund wants to fund most of this project's equity -- in exchange for most of its upside.

choices.label: Take the JV (fund 50-80% for 50-80% of profit)

event_cards.basis: Blue Owl/Crusoe Abilene JV; Meta Hyperion SPV, 2025 (sourced)

event_cards.title: How Long Does a GPU Really Last?
event_cards.body: A well-known short-seller argues everyone in this industry is understating how fast GPUs lose value. Nvidia pushes back hard two weeks later. Which depreciation schedule do you file under?

choices.label: Aggressive: 5-6 year schedule (flatters EBITDA and credit rating)
Conservative: 2-3 year schedule (safer, lower reported profit)

event_cards.basis: Michael Burry critique / Nvidia rebuttal, Nov 2025 (sourced)

event_cards.title: The Cluster Keeps Dropping Nodes
event_cards.body: Your ops team reports another interruption -- the third this week. Most are automated recoveries, but a few nodes need real repair.

choices.label: Run degraded until the next maintenance window

event_cards.basis: Meta Llama 3 training run: 466 interruptions over 54 days, ~50% GPU/HBM3-related (sourced)

event_cards.title: Nine Figures, Blocked
event_cards.body: Data-center projects worth more than a hundred billion dollars just got blocked or delayed nationwide in a single quarter. Yours could be next if Heat keeps climbing.

choices.label: Slow down this quarter's build to manage Heat

event_cards.basis: Data Center Watch Q1 2026 report: ~$130B blocked/delayed (sourced)

event_cards.title: The State Says Not Now
event_cards.body: Your region just announced a moratorium on new data-center permits while it studies the grid impact. Anything not already under construction is frozen.
event_cards.basis: NY EO 62 moratorium, 14 Jul 2026; Gallup 71% opposition poll, 13 May 2026 (sourced)

event_cards.title: Your Lender Wants More
event_cards.body: The GPU-backed debt market just repriced. Any new financing this quarter costs 150-250 basis points more than it did in the spring.

choices.label: Lock in remaining financing now, before it widens further

event_cards.title: A Tenant Invokes Force Majeure
event_cards.body: A marquee AI-lab tenant just told its landlords it won't make this quarter's lease payment, citing conditions beyond its control. It hasn't defaulted -- technically. Everyone's credit committee is now re-reading every contract they hold.

choices.label: Renegotiate now, take a haircut to keep the tenant
Hold firm and demand full payment

event_cards.basis: Oracle force majeure, Project Jupiter, 25 Sep 2026 (sourced)

event_cards.title: A New Tenant Wants In
event_cards.body: A GPU cloud is shopping for capacity and your site is on the short list.
event_cards.basis: 18-act-ii-design.md §9 Tenant RFP interrupt, generic random card
